skill.name: lark-note
skill.description: Use explicit Lark or Feishu note IDs to inspect meeting note details, display type, related document tokens, and unified transcripts. The skill routes normal, unknown, and unified note formats to the right Lark CLI or document workflow.
skill.summary: Inspect Lark meeting notes by note ID and route transcripts correctly.
skill.author: larksuite

security_audit.summary: All static findings were false positives caused by Markdown links, inline command examples, fenced CLI examples, and Chinese text. No prompt injection, hidden payload, command injection, or malicious data exfiltration intent was found in SKILL.md or the reference files. The skill should still be used only with authorized Lark notes because it can retrieve meeting content.

content.user_title: Inspect Lark Meeting Notes by Note ID
content.value_statement: Meeting note workflows can stall when only a note ID or embedded vc-node-id is available. This skill routes Lark Note detail, transcript, and document handoffs without guessing identifiers.
actual_capabilities: Looks up note details when the user provides an explicit note_id.
Uses vc-node-id from a fetched Docx transcribe tab as a note ID.
Identifies note_display_type values: normal, unknown, and unified.
Routes normal transcript documents through lark-doc using verbatim_doc_token.
Fetches unified raw transcripts with the Lark note transcript command.
Stops when required note IDs or transcript entry points are missing.
limitations: Does not search meeting notes by title or natural language.
Does not locate notes from meeting_id, calendar_event_id, or minute_token.
Does not read Docx body content itself; it hands that work to lark-doc.
Requires configured lark-cli access and permissions for the target Lark workspace.

use_cases.title: Resolve Known Note IDs
use_cases.description: Support staff can inspect note type and document tokens when a user already has a note ID.

use_cases.title: Read Unified Transcripts
use_cases.description: Meeting owners can fetch raw unified transcripts after detail lookup confirms the correct display type.

use_cases.title: Route Document-Based Notes
use_cases.description: Operations users can extract vc-node-id from a Docx transcribe tab and continue in the Note workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Check a Note ID
prompt_templates.prompt: Use lark-note to inspect this note_id and tell me the note display type and available document tokens: NOTE_ID.

prompt_templates.title: Fetch a Unified Transcript
prompt_templates.prompt: Given note_id NOTE_ID, confirm whether it is unified and fetch the raw transcript only when that route is valid.

prompt_templates.title: Continue from Docx Metadata
prompt_templates.prompt: I fetched a Lark Docx and found vc-node-id NOTE_ID. Use that as the note_id, then route the note correctly.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Mixed Note Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: For this note_id, explain the display type, transcript route, document handoff, and when to stop instead of guessing.

output_examples.input: A user provides a note ID and asks for the meeting note body.
output_examples.output: The skill first identifies the note display type and related document token. It then sends body reading to the document workflow.

output_examples.input: A user asks for who said what in a unified meeting note.
output_examples.output: The skill confirms the note is unified before requesting the raw transcript. It avoids separate transcript document tokens for unified notes.

output_examples.input: A user only knows the meeting title.
output_examples.output: The skill explains that title search is outside scope and routes the user to document or drive search first.

best_practices: Use this skill only after you have an explicit note_id or vc-node-id.
Check note_display_type before choosing a transcript route.
Ask the user before overwriting any existing local transcript output.
anti_patterns: Do not infer note IDs from titles, body text, document tokens, or backlinks.
Do not use unified transcript commands for normal or unknown note types.
Do not treat missing transcript tokens as permission to retry unrelated searches.

faq.question: What input does this skill need?
faq.answer: It needs an explicit note_id, or a vc-node-id found in a fetched Lark Docx transcribe tab.

faq.question: Can it search by meeting title?
faq.answer: No. Title search belongs to Lark Drive or document search before returning to this skill.

faq.question: Can it read the meeting note body?
faq.answer: It identifies the note document token, then hands Docx body reading to lark-doc.

faq.question: When does it fetch raw transcripts?
faq.answer: It fetches raw transcripts only after note_display_type confirms a unified note.

faq.question: What happens for normal notes?
faq.answer: Normal notes use verbatim_doc_token through the document workflow for transcript content.

faq.question: Does it require Lark access?
faq.answer: Yes. The user needs configured lark-cli access and permissions for the target note.
